column1: # How a fault becomes the code the user is told (architecture section 9.3), shared by the Windows
# and Android test suites. Each suite reads this file and checks its own mapping against every
# line that names its platform; neither keeps a copy. See README.md beside this file.
# category      the fault category, lower case
# code          the fault code; only the protocol category maps differently by code
# has_streamed  yes or no: whether the session had streamed when it failed; - for both
# platforms     which suites check the line: windows, android, or both
